ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:2 ratio of high-intensity white/mottled pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal lobes (far-left and far-right) exhibit high-intensity white pigmentation with dark mottling; a central contiguous low-intensity black region occupies the fluke core from the notch to the inferior margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression at the center; approximately 135 degrees; vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude across the entire trailing edge; specific deep rectangular indentation on the left lobe's upper margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the inferior fluke boundary sweeping into sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two circular ring-like scars visible: one on the upper-mid region of the left lobe and one on the upper-mid region of the right lobe; textured clusters present at both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark vertical and diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) localized within the high-intensity white pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rectangular excision (missing tissue) on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense barnacle colonization at the extreme distal points of both the left and right lobes.
